title: Guilty Gear -Strive- Game Streams Jam Kuradoberi Starter Guide
content: Arc System Works streamed a starter guide video on Tuesday for the Guilty Gear -Strive- fighting game introducing the playstyle of upcoming DLC character Jam Kuradoberi. The 2.0 update and season 5 will launch on Thursday. The season 5 pass includes Jam Kuradoberiand Robo-KY, who will launch in the summer.
author: ANN

title: Manga Nihon Banashi Classic Anime Gets Stage Play in August
content: The official website of the Manga Nihon Mukashi Banashi classic anime series announced on Monday that the series is getting a stage play adaptation that will run from August 5-9 at CBGK Shibugeki!! in Shibuya. Actress Norika Fujiwara and child star Nonoka Murakata will star in the stage play.
author: ANN

title: Black Clover Is Going to End & Fans Need to Be Ready
